_about: Simple flags drawn for this demo by make_flags.py from their geometric descriptions. National flags of this kind are in the public domain; colors are approximations of the official values. Look-alike notes were written for this demo.

flags.similarity: Indonesia and Monaco (red over white, the other way round)
Monaco (identical colors, Monaco's flag is squarer), Poland (white over red)
Indonesia (identical colors, Indonesia's flag is longer), Poland (white over red)
Romania (nearly identical, Romania's blue is slightly lighter)
Chad (nearly identical, Chad's blue is slightly darker)
Ireland (orange instead of red, longer flag), Ivory Coast (orange first, green last)
Ivory Coast (same colors in reverse order), Italy (red instead of orange)
Ireland (same colors in reverse order, green on the hoist side)
Luxembourg (lighter, sky blue, and a longer flag)
Slovenia and Slovakia (same stripes plus a coat of arms)
Latvia (darker maroon red, thinner white band)
